summary: Cover unit (湖南农业大学 本科毕业论文 封面模板) is a fillable school-supplied page; block 1 (附件1 封面基本格式) is excluded as preamble style obligation per the accepted checkpoint. Blocks 2–16 are decomposed into ordered parts: fixed labels (university name, document type, location, label/separator boxes), fill_slots (Chinese title, English title, student name, student ID, cohort/major/class composite, advisor name, advisor title, department, submission date), and style_only parts (font/size/spacing notes). Each fill_slot binds a field from field_id_vocabulary whose usage_affordance.allowed_part_roles includes fill_slot.

semantic_judgments.reason: Pure style-only spacer instruction that carries a blank-line format requirement before the university-name line.

parts.text: 湖 南 农 业 大 学

semantic_judgments.reason: "毕业论文（设计）中文题目" exclusively occupies the Chinese thesis title position and is the placeholder text that gets replaced by thesis.title.zh; the parenthetical carries the font/size requirement.
"TITLE OF GRADUATION PAPER" exclusively occupies the English thesis title position and is the placeholder text replaced by thesis.title.en; the parenthetical carries the font/size/case requirement.

parts.text: （根据题目长短四号字空二或三行）

semantic_judgments.reason: Pure style-only vertical-spacing instruction for the English title block.

Leading spacing boxes and "学生姓名" form the fixed label; the parenthetical between label and colon is the label's font/size requirement. "×××" is the name placeholder replaced by author.name.zh. "（或×□×）" is an alternative pattern note for two-character names. The trailing parenthetical is the style requirement for the name value.
Leading boxes and "学□□号" form the fixed label with internal alignment spacing; the colon is the separator; the 12-character "20××…" placeholder is replaced by author.student_id.
Leading boxes and "年级专业及班级" form the fixed label; the colon is the separator; the trailing placeholder pattern is replaced by author.cohort_class as a composite value (cohort + major + class).

Leading boxes and "指导老师及职称：" form the fixed label and separator. "×××" is the advisor name placeholder replaced by advisor.name.zh; the single box is layout spacing between name and title; "教授" is the example title placeholder replaced by advisor.title. The two responsibilities (name vs title) are split because they belong to different fields.

Leading boxes and "学□□院" form the fixed label with internal alignment spacing; the colon is the separator; "××××学院" is replaced by author.department; the trailing parenthetical is a format note requiring the full department name.
Pure style-only vertical-spacing instruction between the basic-information block and the location line.
Location "湖南·长沙" is fixed school content; the parenthetical is the style requirement for that line.
"提交日期" and the colon are the fixed label and separator; "20××年××月" is the year/month placeholder replaced by submission.date.
